Title: REMINDER: SC Regional Qualifier. This weekend

Messages.Author: skippy
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I will be hosting the South Central Regional Qualifier again this year in
College Station, Tx. The Texas Crowd would like to invite everyone down here
for some good V:TES and a fun party.

Where: Memorial Student Center, Texas A&M University. College Station, Tx.
When: April 17th. 1:00 p.m.

Lotsa crash space at my house and a backyard for camping, if you want. :)

Comments and questions welcome,
Oscar Garza
Prince of College Station, Tx
The Crazy Aggie

This is more than likely my last event as Prince of College Station, so i
hope everyone can make it!
